BREAKING: European Union Faction Permanently Deleted Over TOS Violations
The European Union (EU) faction has been permanently deleted and dismantled, according to a final statement from the Office of the Secretary of the President of the EU.

The statement says the shutdown followed "clear and severe violations of the Terms of Service" by the faction's executive leadership, which it says left community authorities no choice but to enforce an irrevocable shutdown.

The Secretary says they are "deeply saddened and frustrated" by the outcome. They add that the President, the Secretary and the faction's administrative team spent extensive time and effort building and managing the EU, and that seeing months of work "rendered void" is a profound disappointment.

The EU had recently acted as a mediator in the Hawazan conflict, issuing a two-day ceasefire order between Hawazan and RUOT. It's unclear what happens to that process now.

BCBN hasn't independently verified the deletion or the details of the violations.

This is the European Union's final statement in BCBN. Now that the faction no longer exists, BCBN will no longer cover it.
